name: iShares Gold Trust (Ondo Tokenized)
oneLiner: IAUon is Ondo's tokenized iShares Gold Trust exposure, a NAV-style ETF tracker for non-U.S. investors rather than a $1 stablecoin.
collateral: Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF exposure referencing iShares Gold Trust (IAU), designed to provide economic exposure to the underlying publicly traded ETF through Ondo GM rather than direct ownership of ETF shares
pegMechanism: NAV-style tokenized ETF tracker rather than a $1 peg; subscriptions, redemptions, and market pricing follow the underlying IAU economic exposure through Ondo Global Markets and eligible investor flows

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ondo Global Markets assets use the Ondo Bridge, which documents LayerZero OFT architecture for GM assets in addition to USDY. Because IAUon is an Ondo GM asset and route accounting depends on that external OFT stack, it is scored as external-lock-mint.

notices.title: Tokenized ETF exposure
notices.message: Ondo GM Tokens provide economic exposure to the underlying ETF but do not give holders direct rights to hold or receive the underlying ETF shares; eligibility restrictions apply.

mintAuthority.summary: IAUon on Ethereum uses AccessControl: MINTER_ROLE held by GMTokenManager (subscription/redemption engine) and OndoOFT (LayerZero bridge for cross-chain minting). DEFAULT_ADMIN is a TimelockController with no PROPOSER_ROLE members — effectively locking admin changes. BSC follows the same pattern with a separate GMTokenManager and OndoOFT.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (Ethereum) — primary minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) = 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c; Blockscout source: GMTokenManager. This contract handles issuer subscription/redemption minting for Ondo Global Markets.

controls.label: OndoOFT (Ethereum) — LayerZero cross-chain minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) = 0x8ffe0da486a4075e7bbb5763fad4732d41f9667c; Blockscout source: OndoOFT. This contract enables LayerZero-based cross-chain mint/burn for IAUon.

controls.label: IAUon Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN TimelockController (no proposers — effectively locked)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0) = 0x3715b2154d2ff4c5b027c7a1f734b53f27bc34f1; Blockscout source: TimelockController. getMinDelay() = 7200 seconds (2 hours). PROPOSER_ROLE count = 0 (no proposers). EXECUTOR_ROLE count = 2 (0x2e55b738... and 0xff1621ee...). With zero proposers, no new operations can be proposed, making admin changes effectively impossible through this path.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025: IAUon (AccessControl ERC20, non-upgradeable). MINTER_ROLE count=2: GMTokenManager (0x2c158b...) + OndoOFT (0x8ffe0d...). DEFAULT_ADMIN = TimelockController (0x3715b2..., 2h delay, 0 proposers — locked). BSC: DEFAULT_ADMIN = 0x8860bbfc... (contract), MINTER_ROLE count=2 (0x91f8aff... GMTokenManager, 0xeb8ceb... OndoOFT). No proxy admin on any deployment.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: IAUon is a tokenized fund-security exposure tracking the iShares Gold Trust through Ondo Global Markets, not allocated physical bullion.
